data.narrative: Exceptional execution on Module 01 requirements decomposition. Extracted 24 rigorous requirements across User, Provider, and Platform tiers with a balanced 15 explicit to 9 implicit ratio. Pinpointed the cancellation specification contradiction and formulated two concrete, buildable options for Product Management with full blast-radius mapping.

dimension_scores.observation: Extracted 24 structured requirements using a three-pass method (verbs, qualifiers, silences) covering functional rules, quality attributes, and constraints.
dimension_scores.evidence: Generated 24 categorized entries in artifacts/requirements/requirements-matrix.md with explicit/implicit tagging and confidence ratings.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified cross-component dependencies between cancellation policies, escrow holds, payment webhooks, and provider earnings displays.
dimension_scores.evidence: Mapped blast radius of cancellation rule change across REQ-04, REQ-06, REQ-11, and REQ-24.

dimension_scores.observation: Flagged high-risk ambiguities early, including payment gateway refund processing fee loss and search SLA feasibility.
dimension_scores.evidence: Quantified search latency requirement to p95 < 100ms and exposed financial fee absorption risks on 100% refund transactions.

dimension_scores.observation: Defined unambiguous requirement statements with clear actor ownership, trigger events, and quantitative acceptance thresholds.
dimension_scores.evidence: Authored distinct requirements separating browse taxonomy, profile viewing, and rating aggregates.

dimension_scores.observation: Immediately detected specification contradiction in updated Paragraph 1 and proposed two implementable policy options instead of stalling.
dimension_scores.evidence: Produced Option 1 (tiered policy with cooling-off floor) and Option 2 (universal appointment lead-time rule) with clear tradeoffs in fix-cancellation-resolution.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized architectural tension between autonomous provider calendar configuration and high-concurrency slot booking.
dimension_scores.evidence: Proposed distributed Redis mutex locking combined with database row locks to prevent double-booking collisions.
